answer: Proof of Work serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to expend computational energy to validate a cryptographic thread. This process acts like the growth of a structural grove, where each block adds stability against adversarial node proliferation. Much like the cooling of basalt crust, the immutable ledger hardens as the cumulative difficulty increases. An attacker incurs an unsustainable financial cost proportional to the hash power required to overwhelm the honest majority.
